notes.title: 1.26 Update Log - Heavenly Chaos
notes.notes:
New Content

New Gameplay: Heavenly Chaos
The Universe Realm has evolved to its final stage, and the Heavenly Dao is in turmoil, profoundly impacting the Immortality-seeking realm. The chaotic Heavenly Dao may bring challenges, but those who adapt and harness these changes might forge new legends in this turbulent era. This experience is suitable for cultivators with basic knowledge of the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/27d91ae1574cd6108102cbc00f472a32966bca30.jpg

Select Heavenly Chaos when starting a new game to enter this new gameplay. Once any Heavenly Dao is activated, the game will trigger a Heavenly Chaos event at a predetermined time based on its rules, completely altering the gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/9b14566e201c7eff003d60be929e00bb57489eb1.png

Chaos Explanation:

Constant Chaos (Over 40 types):
Choose one of three powerful chaos mutations to be permanently effective in this game session.
Constant Chaos mutations are powerful forces that will change gameplay, so choose wisely.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/93986a1f2d8ca29aff9d9374d41b0bd6eb1200c6.png

Turbulent Chaos (Over 100 types each for Cause and Effect):
Select one from each of the four groups of cause and effect to form a complete chaos event, which will trigger once conditions are met.
The mysteries of Turbulent Chaos are for everyone to discover.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/7aef864c9d0f1b54e5e84adacff9cc889b051dd2.png

Yin Yang Chaos (Over 100 types each for Yin and Yang):
Select one from each of the four groups of Yin Yang effects to form a complete chaos event, which will take effect within a certain duration.
Every bit helps, the more the better!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/8440004e84a035ab1a84458d54c3fc8b0e961c02.png



Heavenly Creed Explanation:

Taishi: Gain three consecutive Constant Heavenly Chaos events at the start of a new game.
Taizhong: Trigger one Turbulent/Yin Yang/Constant Heavenly Chaos event every 10/50/100 days.
Taizhen: Trigger one Yin Yang Heavenly Chaos event for every level increase in Sect Reputation; trigger Constant Heavenly Chaos every six times.
Taixu: Each time a Sect disciple achieves a breakthrough, there is a chance to trigger a Heavenly Chaos event.
Taixuan: Cannot manually select the effects of Turbulent Heavenly Chaos and Yin Yang Heavenly Chaos.
Taiyi: After the effects of Turbulent Heavenly Chaos take effect, there is a probability to reset one effect.
Taiji: When obtaining Turbulent Heavenly Chaos and Yin Yang Heavenly Chaos, expand the random range of chaos effects.


Under the influence of Heavenly Chaos, we can no longer predict whether a game session will end in soaring success or relentless misfortune. Best of luck to everyone.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/921e35e2c67d56a15556ff6f53c12c2cf490691a.png

Fixes

Fixed several errors in the help content.
Fixed the issue where characters in graves could not undergo corpse transformation.
Fixed some errors in the target selection panel.
Fixed the issue of incorrect Metal attribute strength calculation in certain situations.
Fixed the issue where greedy characters could not be broken by gift-giving.
Fixed the issue of abnormal expired message counts.
Fixed the issue of incorrect essence output from consuming different Five Elements dishes.


Optimizations

Optimized the color of the blood pool.
Removed the entrance to the Yaoguais' Era, now merged into Heavenly Chaos.
Optimized some translations and omissions in the English version.


Mod Related
Configuration tables and explanations related to Heavenly Chaos are located in: `Settings\Mutation\` and `Scripts\Mutation`. Updated `Mods\APIDoc`.

Best of luck and enjoy the game!

notes.title: 1.25 Update Log
notes.notes:
Long time no see.

Hi, cultivators! We have been keeping the lowest update frequency for years, as it is necessary to maintain a stable mod environment. Now, it is time to kick these annoying bugs out of the game.

We have fixed most bugs. There are some old bugs, such as: sometimes characters stuck each other, Derivative Calculation fail, some UI bugs for uncommon resolutions. And some new bugs, such as: Ye Baixue not belong to the right sect, some yaoguai feature not working, favor errors.

Besides, we fixed some bugs found by ourselves: wrong sleeping position, wrong law effect, cannot form a formation outside, a prologue stuck, and many UI and wording errors.(e.g. skill cd is removed a long time ago but it still exist in some descriptions)

Other then these fixes, we bring you a new content: Heavenly Chaos. We hope it can bring you some interesting challenge.

Note: If you loading old files fail, it can be the result of mods which has modified game files. The only way is to contact the mod author and seek for a solution.

New Content 

New system: Heavenly Chaos
Along with the heavenly rule enterring into the last period, it has been becoming much more chaotic. All kinds of strange phenomenon preveil. To deal with these uncommon things, cultivators arm themselves to teeth to continue their immortal journey.
Heavenly Chaos can be selected in the classic mode.

New Heavenly Chaos Yaoguais' Era
Recently, there is a strange thing happened in the Taiyi Sect. It is said by a hunt, he aimed an shot an arrow into a cow's body. But then the cow started to glow and shinning. After some time, the cow turned into a Beast. The sect leader thought it must be an emergancy, so he discussed with elders and tried to figure out a solution...
Beast convertion: Animals will turn into beasts after death occasionally.
Alchemy Qi Fullness: After a success alchemy, there will be alchemy qi in your sect. The Qi amount is based on the tier and element of the drug.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/6dc55f5b5fa1f64157d837f001b9310c311bf3a2.jpg
Beast Sacrifice: Cast a Beast Sacrifice through ancenstral shrine by offer beast blood and soul pearl to gain random item rewards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/a0d9a71127adc21d7651e7f335b7432bdbc47635.jpg

Optimize
Add Random and Select All function for Immortal difficulty
Optimized the rain and snow visual effect.
Optimized the save load process.
Optimized the size of the tips.
Optimized the blueprint build, now walls with the same material can build on each other.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/e3e12b2d9a12455191433c64c426ffdf6b52eb43.gif

Last but not least, we wish you a happy spring festival in advance!

notes.title: "Amazing Cultivation Simulator" Mobile Version Launching Soon
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that the Amazing Cultivation Simulator mobile version will officially launch in Mainland China on December 20th! Join us in exploring the vast world of cultivation on the small screen and gather at the Taiyi Sect to rekindle the flames of cultivation.

Our "mobile version" journey has spanned over three years, during which we've invested significant effort and time. We've strived to faithfully recreate the authentic Amazing Cultivation Simulator experience of the PC version for mobile, optimizing for mobile gaming habits and introducing new creative content.

Our goal has been to guarantee a seamless and refined gaming experience on the mobile version, thanks to your unwavering support and patience. We are grateful for your support and would like to express our heartfelt thanks.

In addition, the mobile version's release in the Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan regions, as well as international markets, is currently in full swing. Stay tuned for exciting updates as we approach the public beta. We can't wait to reunite with you in the mobile world of Amazing Cultivation Simulator.

GSQ
November 23, 2023

Everyone, please be assured that ACS2 is progressing as planned, with 90% of our company's resources dedicated to its development. However, creating games is almost like burning money, We have very ambitious goals for ACS2, so in fact, the financial support provided by the mobile version is a very important part of the ACS2 development process.

acs1 has also accumulated many optimizations and adjustments, but we need the right timing to release them in order to maintain mod stability.

notes.title: Announcement of the Delayed Release of Amazing Cultivation Simulator 2
notes.notes:
I'm sorry


Hello everyone, we are very sorry to announce that the "Amazing Cultivation Simulator 2" originally planned to be released in 2023 will be postponed to 2024.

In November 2020, we announced the birth of "Amazing Cultivation Simulator 2". During these two and a half years, we have been working very hard to develop the game, overcoming countless difficulties at work and at home. However, the development process is really tough! 

The main reason is that our ambition is bigger than our ability, and we simply cannot finish everything on time. (But as the saying goes, is it really a good game if it's released on time?) 

Anyway, the fact is that our incompetence led to the delay, and we apologize for that.

We know that waiting is painful, so starting from this month, we will launch a monthly update called "The Chronicles of Langhuan". Based on the personal experience of a novice cultivator named "Little Pacaicai", the update will showcase all aspects of the two worlds in Amazing Cultivation Simulator 2 while preserving the core surprises, hoping to ease your longing for the game.

We sincerely appreciate your support and encouragement over the years, which has given us the strength to move forward. Please believe that we will forge a grand and unforgettable cultivation world with even greater determination. 

All good things are worth waiting and fighting for!


GSQ

June 20, 2023

notes.title: 2nd Anniversary Celebration - Update Log
notes.notes:
Amazing Cultivation Simulator originally started Early Access on Jan 11, 2019. It’s almost two years from then, all we want to say is thank you!
Now let’s check the 2nd anniversary update content. Please keep in mind that a special sale will begin on Jan 11, 2021 along with the update. During the period you could buy the game with 10% discount.  

New Buildings 
·Added four new flooring styles
[Deep in the Bamboo forest] Added bamboo wall, bamboo door, bamboo roof. The style will automatically change if using bamboo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/169fa4852b4f55e0ab1576409f9a1439002de89e.gif

New Equipment: Mantle
·Added four normal mantles: Fire Mantle, Cloud Mantle, Dark Mantle, Light Mantle. They can be made on the sewing table.
·Added several special mantles such as Sky Fire Extinct, Freeze Cloud Blizzard, Dark Body's Shadow. Some of them can be gained by winning the Kunlun Fair, opening new year's goods and some of them can be made on the sewing table after slaughtering the ancient beasts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/7148b5d66cb221692c478013089b45f0de5f9934.gif


New equipment: Spirit Contract
·Added 12 different spirit contracts
After equipped with a spirit contract, one can gain a huge amount of adventure speed. Besides, characters will gain extra properties if they reach higher states. After reaching the golden core state, they will gain extra Max Qi. After the Primordial state, they will gain different special abilities for different contracts, as below:
Rabbit: Extra Adventure Speed.
Chicken: Extra Perception.
Wolf: Extra Artifact Mastery.
Snake: Extra Spell.
Boar: Extra Constitution.
Bear: Extra Constitution, extra Artifact Mastery.
Frog: Extra Qi Sense.
Turtle: Extra Protect.
Cat: Extra Artisanry.
Bull: Extra Constitution, extra Alchemy.
Tiger: Extra Battle, extra Artifact Mastery.
[Deep in the Bamboo forest]Panda: Extra Luck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/cdaef4e52ce8926924ec50f10c125c51f94c7558.gif

·Added 2 special spirit contracts
There are 2 different special spirit contracts: Lushu and Fei contract. They can only be bought from auctions. These contracts cannot benefit for battles but can enable characters to use Lushu and Fei's original miracle to call rain or dispel clouds.·
·Sixteen Supreme Laws: Seal Contract
It can be cast to an unconscious monster in a lower state than you can seal it into a spirit contract. The higher the monster state is, the higher the contract effect will be.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/07ec96cdd45a86d198fcaf6445b01be027fd9b79.gif

·Added a new setting: Spirit Fly(beside mindful dresser). After it is ticked, this character will always ride on the contract while moving.

notes.title: 1.0 English version release on November 25 - A herald on Adventure Mode!
notes.notes:
Is there anyone thinking we are going to release the 1.0 version on November 2021 - according to the yellow-background breaking news from us?

Now we are going to announce officially - Amazing Cultivation Simulator ver 1.0 will release on November 25, 2020! It will be FULLY localized to English, Including a new English tutorial.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/38a39946e2c4dd234b85f0b435929238506a3c9f.jpg

As one of the core updates in version 1.0, 'Adventure Mode' enables players to adventure in certain maps or facilities with a selected disciple. 'Dojo', 'Heaven echo Altar', 'Town of Nowhere', etc... new missions and challenges will be brought to the players.

'Dojo' is a new facility. The disciples can enter it by camping/descending and competitive with other disciples. You can check which of your disciples is more powerful through sending 2 of those into 'The arena of martial arts' and watch them contest with each other.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/2de0a1bfdb3db050ddcdb42e4984b3922cce7bcd.png

'Heaven echo Altar' is a PVP arena. Players can log in their most powerful discipal and generate a set of code of this 'Heaven'echo Alter' Room. Share the code with your friends, and then you can practice with your friend's disciple!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825629/0fd553831a74416b2e3648b76cf2211060e14b67.png

'Town of Nowhere' is a collection of special missions.It will open after finish the secret happen at the 375th days. Player can challenge from shallow part to deep boundaries. The farther you run into it, the harder the challenge you will face to. Challenge to the extreme and fight the impossible there!

Are you already looking forward to the 'Adventure Mode'? This is one of the main updates for version 1.0 - More details are on their way to be disclosed! 
The information about the first DLC will also be published in the near future.
